purpose: dedicated independent QA hosting plan; not an actual deployment
notes: This is a proposed independent project name; no project existence or domain registration is asserted.
Cloudflare Pages previews are publicly accessible by default unless a Cloudflare Access policy is configured.
The current repository wrangler.jsonc targets beagu-index and must not be used to deploy candidate QA.
The QA hosting workflow cannot run deployment jobs while the hard-coded publication lock is true.
Any future activation requires an explicit user approval, separate QA project setup, protected credentials, and reviewed code change.
